{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.18

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|gr2= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns primary and secondary weapon holders of a dead unit. If a unit had weapons at the moment of death, primary weapon is dropped into primary weaponholder and secondary weapon is dropped into secondary.

|s1= [[getCorpseWeaponholders]] corpse

|p1= corpse: [[Object]] - dead unit

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Object]]s in format [primaryWeaponHolder, secondaryWeaponHolder]

|x1= <sqf>systemChat str getCorpseWeaponholders cursorObject;</sqf>

|seealso= [[getCorpse]] [[nearSupplies]] [[allDeadMen]]
}}
